title: Engine operations
description: The functions through which the page and the tests drive a game.

entities.name: Make a game
entities.description: A Game on its title screen, with its generator seeded.
entities.authorization: None: in-process code. The page (src/main.ts) and the tests construct it.
entities.result: A Game in the attract phase with a burrow dug and the puffin and hunters at their starting places; the seed feeds the generator every later game draws its burrows from. best is 0 until the page sets it.

entities.name: Step a game
entities.description: Moves the game on by one sixtieth of a second with one step's Input.
entities.authorization: None: in-process code. The page calls it sixty times a second; the tests call it directly.
entities.result: The game is changed in place. start begins a game from the title screen or the game-over screen, or a real game from a demo; pause toggles the pause in ready and play; dir is the way the puffin will turn. What happened in the step is collected for takeEvents().
failures: A start press on the game-over screen does nothing in its first 45 steps.
A pause press does something only in the ready and play phases of a real game: not on the title or game-over screens, not in a demo, and not while a puffin is being caught or a burrow cleared.
While paused, every other input is ignored.

entities.name: Start a game or a demo
entities.description: Starts a game from burrow 1, as a real game or as a demo.
entities.authorization: None: in-process code. step() calls it on a start press; the page calls newGame(true) for the title screen's demo.
entities.result: Score 0, three puffins, burrow 1, a new base seed drawn for this game's burrows, the pause cleared, the ready phase begun, and a start event collected.

entities.name: Take the events
entities.description: Hands over what has happened since the last call.
entities.authorization: None: in-process code. The page calls it after every step and plays a sound for each event.
entities.result: The collected GameEvents, in order; the Game's list is emptied.

entities.name: Dig a burrow
entities.authorization: None: in-process code. Game.loadLevel and the tests call it.
entities.result: A Maze: the seed, every tile as turf, tunnel, den or door, the tiles that start with a sand eel, the four that start with a feather, and the row whose tunnel runs off the island's sides. The same seed always gives the same Maze.

entities.name: Ask the simple player for a direction
entities.description: Which way a simple player would point the puffin now.
entities.authorization: None: in-process code. The page calls it on every step of a demo; the tests use it to play burrows.
entities.result: A direction, 0 to 3. It reads the Game and changes nothing.
failures: -1 outside the ready and play phases, or when no tunnel leads on.
